Message:
I can’t believe
Fenrir an’ Cerberus
are at the Duke’s mansion, too!

We became friends
back on that mountain!

This takes me back...
I remember the three o’ us
foragin’ for wild edible plants,
an’ chasin’ after bugs...

It wasn’t for very long,
but it sure was fun.

I’m real glad the two of them
are able to smile
like that again now.
Despite what happened, n’ all...

A pang ran through my chest.
What happened to them
was likely all because I...!

“...! Oh no, it’s nothin’,
Fenrir, Cerberus.
So, don’t pay me no mind!”

“So, yuh both traveled to
a bunch o’ countries
with the Duke,
an’ even made
candy together? Huh...

Knowin’ yuh’ve made
so many fun memories
makes me happy, too.”

“I can make memories
with the two o’ yuh
from now on, too...?
But, I don’t have the right to...

’Cause I...I was the one
who abandoned the two o’ yuh...
